purpose: Teach: オペラ/ラップ/スカウト/モバイル/プログラミング/思い切り/新車/停車

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、オペラ、絶対、見たことないんだ
lines.en: Mom, I'm being serious — I've literally never seen an opera before.
lines.style: Earnest, persistent repetition. Genuine bewilderment laced with the certainty only a child can have. Slight breathlessness — he's building to his real point. Eyes fixed on her face.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、若い頃、絶対、ラップ、絶対、好きだったのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad, I'm telling you, when he was younger — he was absolutely into rap, Sho.
lines.style: Warm remembrance, almost amused at the memory. Speaking to Sho but half-speaking to herself. Soft, reflective tempo. Like she's pulling out a story she hasn't thought about in years.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、サッカーで、絶対、スカウト、絶対、されたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really mean it — I want to get scouted for soccer. That's what I actually want.
lines.style: Direct, almost urgent for a quiet child. This matters and he needs her to know it matters. Steady eye contact. No wavering, but small voice — vulnerable underneath the conviction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、モバイル、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、時間、絶対、決めようね
lines.en: Sho, sweetheart — we need to set some actual limits on your phone games, okay? Really.
lines.style: Gentle but firm, the way she is when she means it. Not scolding. Matter-of-fact kindness — the tone that says 'I'm not angry, I just care about this.' Slow enough he feels heard.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、プログラミング、絶対、お仕事、絶対、しているんだよね
lines.en: Mom — Dad does programming for work, right? That's his job?
lines.style: Wondering aloud, piecing things together. Not asking for correction, but confirmation. The small curiosity of a child who notices his father's focus but doesn't quite understand it yet. Gentle, open.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、運動会、絶対、思い切り、絶対、走って来てね
lines.en: Sho, I want you to run your very best at the sports day, okay? Give it everything.
lines.style: Encouragement with real weight behind it. Not cheerleading — this is her belief in him, spoken clearly. Warm, present. The tone of a mother who knows he can do hard things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、新車、絶対、買ったの?本気で
lines.en: Mom — did Dad actually buy a new car? Like, really?
lines.style: Surprise and curiosity firing at once. Quick, slightly higher pitch on the question. The tone of a child who's noticed something and wants confirmation that his observation is real.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: バス停の、本気で、絶対、停車、絶対、位置、絶対、気をつけてね、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, be very careful when you're around the bus stop — watch where it stops, alright? That's important.
lines.style: Serious, attentive. The shift into genuine caution. Not alarming, but clear — this is safety. Speaking to him like he's old enough to understand why this matters, which he is.
